facts.wand-raised: In his right hand he holds a white wand raised high above his head.
facts.finger-down: The index finger of his left hand points at the ground.
facts.lemniscate: Above his head floats a sideways figure eight (∞).
facts.table-tools: On the table in front of him lie a cup, a pentacle (a disc engraved with a star), and a sword, and a wand is there with them as well.
facts.robes: He wears a red cloak over a white robe, with a blue band around his waist.
facts.roses-lilies: Red roses and white lilies bloom along the bottom, and a rose vine also hangs down from the top edge.
facts.yellow-ground: The background is a bright yellow.

glosses.table-tools: The tools he needs are already within reach.
glosses.lemniscate: Will and focus that continue without breaking.

reversedGloss.blocked: He can do something, but he cannot make himself press start.
reversedGloss.excess: Skill with words and showmanship run ahead of the actual preparation.

misdescriptions.wrong: There is a crystal ball on the table.
Both hands are raised toward the sky.
Flames shoot out of the wand.
